parsed.rationale: Invoice page CSV export button started returning a 500 error this morning and affects only the invoice page; finance needs it fixed before Friday close. This is a product defect requiring engineering.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi team,

Thanks for flagging this—sorry for the trouble. We can confirm the CSV export button on the invoice page is returning a 500 error, and that customer exports are not affected.

We’ll have Engineering investigate the invoice-page export failure specifically. In the meantime, please keep using the manual workaround if possible to support finance through Friday close.

To help us narrow it down quickly, could you share:
1) The approximate time the issue started (including your timezone)
2) The exact invoice URL (or invoice ID) where the export fails
3) Any request/response details you can capture from the export attempt (e.g., correlation/request ID from the error page or browser network trace)

Once we have the above, we’ll continue the investigation and update you on the status of the fix.
